overrides.claim: 32% of liver transplantation programs required patients to discontinue methadone treatment in 2001.
overrides.primary_evidence: Patients receiving methadone maintenance are accepted by 56% of the responding programs. Approximately 180 patients receiving methadone maintenance are reported to have undergone liver transplantation.
overrides.counter_evidence: Ninety-four percent have addiction treatment requirements.

overrides.claim: A diminished ovarian reserve is a very strong indicator of infertility, even in an a priori non-infertile population.
overrides.primary_evidence: Objective To determine the associations between biomarkers of ovarian reserve and reproductive potential among women of late reproductive age. Conclusions and Relevance Among women aged 30 to 44 years without a history of infertility who had been trying to conceive for 3 months or less, biomarkers indicating diminished ovarian reserve compared with normal ovarian reserve were not associated with reduced fertility.
overrides.counter_evidence: Conclusions and Relevance Among women aged 30 to 44 years without a history of infertility who had been trying to conceive for 3 months or less, biomarkers indicating diminished ovarian reserve compared with normal ovarian reserve were not associated with reduced fertility.

overrides.claim: Asymptomatic visual impairment screening in elderly populations leads to improved vision.
overrides.primary_evidence: OBJECTIVE To assess whether population screening for impaired vision among older people in the community leads to improvements in vision. Visual impairment in this age group can usually be reduced with treatment.
overrides.counter_evidence: CONCLUSIONS Screening of asymptomatic older people in the community is not justified on present evidence.

overrides.claim: Charcoal is an effective treatment for acute paraquat poisoning.
overrides.primary_evidence: The present study retrospectively analyzed 19 patients diagnosed with paraquat (PQ) poisoning with the aim to investigate the effect of activated charcoal hemoperfusion on renal function and PQ elimination. There was a linear correlation between plasma and urine paraquat concentration prior to and during activated charcoal hemoperfusion.
overrides.counter_evidence: Activated charcoal hemoperfusion had little effect on avoiding acute kidney injury in patients with severe PQ poisoning.

overrides.claim: Cognitive behavioral therapy is an ineffective treatment for insomnia
overrides.primary_evidence: OBJECTIVE To examine short- and long-term clinical efficacy of cognitive behavioral therapy (CBT) and pharmacological treatment in older adults experiencing chronic primary insomnia. Data from this study on the treatment of chronic, severe insomnia (a small subset of all insomnia) are not generalizable to the typical insomnia patient.
overrides.counter_evidence: RESULTS CBT resulted in improved short- and long-term outcomes compared with zopiclone on 3 out of 4 outcome measures.

overrides.claim: Commelina yellow mottle virus (ComYMV) has three typical badnavirus ORFs, capable of encoding proteins 23, 15, and 216 kD.
overrides.primary_evidence: We have characterized the viral transcript and determined the complete sequence of the genome of Commelina mellow mottle virus (CoYMV), a member of this group. A new badnavirus was discovered from pagoda trees showing yellow mosaic symptoms on the leaves by high throughput sequencing of small RNAs.
overrides.counter_evidence: Analysis of the viral transcript indicates that the virus encodes a single terminally-redundant genome-length plus 120 nucleotide transcript.

overrides.claim: Cost effectiveness evaluations based on cRCT data accurately reflect prices for patients in actual clinical practice.
overrides.primary_evidence: The objective of this study was to evaluate the external validity of published cost-effectiveness studies by comparing the data used in these studies (typically based on RCTs) to observational data from actual clinical practice. CONCLUSION Evaluating the cost effectiveness of prognostic biomarkers is important even when effects at an individual level are small.
overrides.counter_evidence: CONCLUSIONS The published cost-effectiveness analyses of coxibs lacked external validity, did not represent patients in actual clinical practice, and should not have been used to inform prescribing policies.

overrides.claim: Deltex has no known interactions with eIF3f.
overrides.primary_evidence: We show that eIF3f has an intrinsic DUB activity. Knocking down eIF3f leads to an accumulation of monoubiquitinated forms of activated Notch, an effect counteracted by murine WT eIF3f but not by a catalytically inactive mutant.
overrides.counter_evidence: We also show that eIF3f is recruited to activated Notch on endocytic vesicles by the putative E3 ubiquitin ligase Deltex1, which serves as a bridging factor.

overrides.claim: Diminished ovarian reserve is a reliable indicator of infertility in a non-infertile population.
overrides.primary_evidence: Objective To determine the associations between biomarkers of ovarian reserve and reproductive potential among women of late reproductive age. Conclusions and Relevance Among women aged 30 to 44 years without a history of infertility who had been trying to conceive for 3 months or less, biomarkers indicating diminished ovarian reserve compared with normal ovarian reserve were not associated with reduced fertility.
overrides.counter_evidence: Conclusions and Relevance Among women aged 30 to 44 years without a history of infertility who had been trying to conceive for 3 months or less, biomarkers indicating diminished ovarian reserve compared with normal ovarian reserve were not associated with reduced fertility.

overrides.claim: Human embryonic stem cells give rise to cell types from all three embryonic germ layers.
overrides.primary_evidence: When grafted into SCID mice, both lines give rise to teratomas containing derivatives of all three embryonic germ layers. Embryonic stem cells provide a model to study early human embryology, an investigational tool for discovery of novel growth factors and medicines, and a potential source of cells for use in transplantation therapy.
overrides.counter_evidence: Both cell lines differentiate in vitro into extraembryonic and somatic cell lineages.

overrides.claim: Incidence of heart failure increased by 10% in women since 1979.
overrides.primary_evidence: RESULTS The incidence of heart failure was higher among men (378/100 000 persons; 95% confidence interval [CI], 361-395 for men; 289/100 000 persons; 95% CI, 277-300 for women) and did not change over time among men or women. CONCLUSION In this community-based cohort, the incidence of heart failure has not declined during 2 decades, but survival after onset of heart failure has increased overall, with less improvement among women and elderly persons.
overrides.counter_evidence: RESULTS The incidence of heart failure was higher among men (378/100 000 persons; 95% confidence interval [CI], 361-395 for men; 289/100 000 persons; 95% CI, 277-300 for women) and did not change over time among men or women.

overrides.claim: Most termination events in Okazaki fragments are dictated by initiation patterns.
overrides.primary_evidence: Via the deep sequencing of Okazaki fragments, we comprehensively document replication fork directionality throughout the S. Using a strain in which late origins can be induced to fire early, we show that replication termination is a largely passive phenomenon that does not rely on cis-acting sequences or replication fork pausing.
overrides.counter_evidence: The replication profile is predominantly determined by the kinetics of origin firing, allowing us to reconstruct chromosome-wide timing profiles from an asynchronous culture.

overrides.claim: Notch signaling occurs between tumor cells and stromal cells.
overrides.primary_evidence: We recently demonstrated that Notch signaling is involved in proliferation and survival of B cell-derived tumor cells of classic Hodgkin disease and described a novel mechanism for the oncogenic capacity of Notch. In this study we investigated whether Notch signaling is involved in the tight interactions between neoplastic plasma cells and their bone marrow microenvironment, which are essential for tumor cell growth in multiple myeloma (MM).
overrides.counter_evidence: Notch receptors expressed on hematopoietic stem cells interact with their ligands on bone marrow stromal cells and thereby control cell fate decisions and survival.

overrides.claim: Patients with common epithelial cancers are less likely to have an emergency event as their first hospital admission if they live in resource-deprived areas.
overrides.primary_evidence: RESULTS Patients from deprived areas, older people, and women were more likely to be admitted as emergencies. Patients with colonic cancer were very significantly less likely to receive any treatment if they came from any but the most affluent area (ORs 0.639, 0.603 and 0.544 in increasingly deprived quartiles), this may have been exacerbated if the hospital was distant from their residence (OR for forth quartile for both travel and deprivation 0.731, not significant).
overrides.counter_evidence: RESULTS Patients from deprived areas, older people, and women were more likely to be admitted as emergencies.

overrides.claim: Pioneer factor OCT3/4 interacts with major chromatin remodeling factors.
overrides.primary_evidence: Purified Oct4, Sox2, and Klf4 proteins can bind nucleosomes in vitro, and in vivo they preferentially target silent sites enriched for nucleosomes. Our findings provide insight into how pioneer factors can target naive chromatin sites.
overrides.counter_evidence: FoxA, the paradigm pioneer TF, has a winged helix DBD that resembles linker histone and thereby binds its target sites on nucleosomes and in compacted chromatin.

overrides.claim: Pyridostatin reduces proliferation of homologous recombination - defective cells.
overrides.primary_evidence: Treatment with the G4-stabilizing compound pyridostatin (PDS) increases telomere fragility in BRCA2-deficient cells, suggesting that G4 formation drives telomere instability. BLM, WRN, and p53 are involved in the homologous DNA recombination pathway.
overrides.counter_evidence: Treatment with the G4-stabilizing compound pyridostatin (PDS) increases telomere fragility in BRCA2-deficient cells, suggesting that G4 formation drives telomere instability.

overrides.claim: Removal of H3K9me3 by ectopic expression of other H3K9 demethylases decreases reprogramming efficiency in SCNT experiments.
overrides.primary_evidence: Here we show that overexpression of a related H3K9me3 demethylase KDM4A improves human SCNT, and that, as in mice, H3K9me3 in the human somatic cell genome is an SCNT reprogramming barrier. Furthermore, we show that interactions between RNA and KDM4E are essential for H3K9 demethylation during EGA.
overrides.counter_evidence: Here we show that overexpression of a related H3K9me3 demethylase KDM4A improves human SCNT, and that, as in mice, H3K9me3 in the human somatic cell genome is an SCNT reprogramming barrier.

overrides.claim: Systemic immunosuppressive (IS) therapy increases the chance of cancer mortality in patients with inflammatory eye disease (IED)
overrides.primary_evidence: DESIGN Retrospective cohort study evaluating overall and cancer mortality in relation to immunosuppressive drug exposure among patients with ocular inflammatory diseases. For patients unexposed to immunosuppressive treatment, risks of death overall (standardised mortality ratio 1.02, 95% confidence interval [CI] 0.94 to 1.11) and from cancer (1.10, 0.93 to 1.29) were similar to those of the US population.
overrides.counter_evidence: Patients who used azathioprine, methotrexate, mycophenolate mofetil, ciclosporin, systemic corticosteroids, or dapsone had overall and cancer mortality similar to that of patients who never took immunosuppressive drugs.

overrides.claim: Taking 400mg of α-tocopheryl acetate in combination with vitamin C reduces the risk of prostate cancer.
overrides.primary_evidence: CONCLUSIONS In this large, long-term trial of male physicians, neither vitamin E nor C supplementation reduced the risk of prostate or total cancer. Some human and animal studies indicate that plasma concentrations of gamma-tocopherol are inversely associated with the incidence of cardiovascular disease and prostate cancer.
overrides.counter_evidence: CONCLUSIONS In this large, long-term trial of male physicians, neither vitamin E nor C supplementation reduced the risk of prostate or total cancer.

overrides.claim: The DESMOND program demonstrates no significant impact on biochemical outcomes.
overrides.primary_evidence: The overall evidence rating was low to very low for important outcomes such as pre-eclampsia, gestational diabetes, gestational hypertension, and preterm delivery. No patients received ALK inhibitor therapy.
overrides.counter_evidence: Dietary intervention resulted in the largest reduction in maternal gestational weight gain (3.84 kg, 2.45 to 5.22 kg), with improved pregnancy outcomes compared with other interventions.

overrides.claim: The DESMOND program demonstrates no significant impact on lifestyles outcomes.
overrides.primary_evidence: With all interventions combined, there were no significant differences in birth weight (mean difference -50 g, -100 to 0 g) and the incidence of large for gestational age (relative risk 0.85, 0.66 to 1.09) or small for gestational age (1.00, 0.78 to 1.28) babies between the groups, though by itself physical activity was associated with reduced birth weight (mean difference -60 g, -120 to -10 g). The overall evidence rating was low to very low for important outcomes such as pre-eclampsia, gestational diabetes, gestational hypertension, and preterm delivery.
overrides.counter_evidence: Dietary intervention resulted in the largest reduction in maternal gestational weight gain (3.84 kg, 2.45 to 5.22 kg), with improved pregnancy outcomes compared with other interventions.

overrides.claim: The DESMOND program demonstrates no significant impact on weight loss.
overrides.primary_evidence: The groups differed on weight lost at 24 months. Surgery generates substantial weight loss, but 20–30% fails to achieve successful weight loss.
overrides.counter_evidence: CONCLUSIONS This study demonstrates the ability of TTM-based tailored feedback to improve healthy eating, exercise, managing emotional distress, and weight on a population basis.

overrides.claim: The density of cytokine receptor bearing cells has no effect on the distance over which cytokines act.
overrides.primary_evidence: Here, we used theoretical considerations and experimental models of immune responses in vitro and in vivo to quantify the spatial extent of cytokine communications in dense tissues. Such heterogeneous distributions of cytokines were a source of non‐genetic cell‐to‐cell variability that is often overlooked in single‐cell studies.
overrides.counter_evidence: The size of these self‐assembled niches scaled with the density of cytokine‐consuming cells, a parameter that gets tuned during immune responses.

overrides.claim: The recruitment of Wdr5 to its target loci depends on Kat8.
overrides.primary_evidence: FISH showed that, although they were heterogeneous, breakpoints on 9p resulted in the partial or complete deletion of PAX5. This approach identified 5 fusion gene partners with PAX5: LOC392027 (7p12.1), SLCO1B3 (12p12), ASXL1 (20q11.1), KIF3B (20q11.21), and C20orf112 (20q11.1).
overrides.counter_evidence: FISH showed that, although they were heterogeneous, breakpoints on 9p resulted in the partial or complete deletion of PAX5.
